label: hb-stan-d29-d100
note: Stan arm of the HB baseline (issue 129): joint three-level model in pystan at 2000/2000/4 on the same D~29 and D~100 cohorts as the NumPyro rungs
record_note: The models package is pinned to a BRANCH in the HPC CPU env, not a release: hb_three_level.stan ships in that package (next to the NumPyro model it ports) and is absent from the 0.14.0 the env previously carried. Installed --no-deps --force-reinstall; reverts by reinstalling the release. An earlier launch of this same sweep (sweep d5fij9gq, job 25579870) died in ~1 min during Hydra composition because launch_hpc.py injected model.training.auto_heldout_finetune.output_root unconditionally and HB configs have no training block; that launcher guard is fixed in dispatcher f284584 and this record is the first launch after it.
deviations: No held-out scoring: HBStanTrainer fits the population only, so this run logs no heldout/* metrics and is NOT an HB rung on the scaling curve.

reduce_sum runs serially because httpstan does not define STAN_THREADS, so parallelism is one core per chain. The 8 CPUs requested leave headroom but only 4 are used for sampling; Stan wall time here is a floor on what a threaded CmdStan build could do.
D~100 has no finished NumPyro comparator at any setting, so its number stands alone until one lands.
